title: RAG study question, datasets v2 (three tiers, domain-neutral)
description: One JSON object per line in work/datasets_v2/{dev,dev_check,dev_legacy,test}/*.jsonl. Agreed 2026-09-25 (DESIGN.md section 8). Methods may see only: id, question, language, pool_id and the run condition's scope. Everything else is evaluator-only. The review game shows question, expected_answer, requirements (answer points), evidence (highlighted in the source text), integration_operation, necessity_audit / absence_audit and notes.

revision.description: Incremented on every substantive edit (question, answer, requirements, evidence).

subset.description: Pre-declared subsets; 'reserve' = over-produced replacement, with reserve_rank.

reserve_rank.description: Replacement order inside the stratum (reserve items only).

tier.description: Set by the simplest sufficient evidence in the frozen pool (DESIGN.md section 2). null for unanswerable questions.

intended_tier.description: For unanswerable questions: the task attempted. Otherwise equal to tier or null.

pool_id.description: Frozen pool manifest id: RPT-fa, RPT-en, BOOK-fa, BOOK-en, LAW-fa, LAW-en. Never gold-derived.

doc_scope.description: Primary run condition: 'pool' (the whole pool). The oracle scopes for the diagnostics are listed separately so the primary scope is never gold-derived.

oracle_docs.description: Diagnostic only: the source document (T1/T2) or a sufficient document set (T3).

question.description: In the question's language; native wording.

question_gloss_en.description: English gloss for Persian questions (review aid, never given to methods).

expected_answer.description: Reference answer in the question's language. States every required requirement; optional ones may appear.

answer_format.description: Shared answer contract (same format and output allowance for every method).

requirements.description: Atomic answer obligations. Empty for unanswerable questions. Operands that only support a derived result are required=false unless the question asks for them.

proposition.description: The obligation as one short sentence (shown in the game as an answer point).

subject.description: Entity the requirement is about: company, law/article, book/person/place, etc.

label.description: Property or relation name, e.g. 'employee headcount', 'notice period for dismissal', 'cause of the revolt'.

constraints.description: All optional; null when not applicable.

version.description: Edition, revision, amendment or report year when it defines the source version.

population.description: Whose figure: employees vs users, drivers vs active drivers, etc.

unit.description: Reporting unit the question fixes (e.g. 'in million toman').

condition.description: Applicability condition or scenario (e.g. 'if the employer is at fault').

definition.description: Definition the source gives for the aspect (kept separate from condition).

value.description: Expected value: number, string, list of strings, boolean, or [low, high] for an interval.

unit.description: Measurement unit of value (people, %, EUR million, days, articles...).

required.description: Must appear in a strictly correct answer.

comparability.description: Why the inputs are comparable (same definition, period, population, currency).

evidence.description: Every piece of source text the answer rests on, incl. binding labels (table headers, units, dates). Empty for unanswerable questions.

quote.description: Exact substring of the frozen document text.

start.description: Document-relative Unicode code-point offset, half-open [start, end).

text_sha256.description: sha256 of the frozen document text the offsets refer to.

role.description: answer (T1); operand/item (values or list items); bridge (links question to where the answer is); rule/exception/definition (legal and definitional integration); qualifier (unit, period, population, header binding a value); context.

region.description: Label of the evidence region (e.g. section path); regions define T2 integration.

evidence_bundles.description: Each bundle = a complete, sufficient set of evidence ids (all pieces needed); alternative bundles are interchangeable. At least one bundle for answerable questions.

accepted_alternatives.description: requirement id -> accepted alternative answers (e.g. other units).

integration_operation.description: T2/T3: the named operation (resolve definition and apply, rule + exception, compare and derive, bounded synthesis, cross-time comparison, bridge, aggregation).

regions.description: T2: the distinct regions; T3: the documents.

single_document_complete.description: Must be false for T3; true for T2.

restatement_search.description: What was searched for restated or derivable answers, where, and the result.

pool_hash.description: sha256 of the frozen pool manifest the audit was run against.

neighbouring_facts.description: Plausible traps (unit ids + what they say).

descriptive.description: Computed by the verifier; flags only, never tier gates.

source_block.description: Allocation and bootstrap unit; entirely in one split.

source_family.description: Work/company family (all editions/volumes/years of one work or company).

matches.description: Earlier question ids / unit ids that triggered the class.

review.description: Agent review, then the user's game verdict, bound to content_hash.

reviewed_hash.description: content_hash at the time of the user's verdict; a mismatch voids acceptance.

content_hash.description: sha256 over question, expected_answer, answer_format, requirements, evidence, evidence_bundles (canonical JSON).
